scope: Fresh fixed-seed development evidence only; no model calls or independent results read.
failure_model: Actual vendored axis_fifo plus existing artificial output boundary mutations; not a historical upstream defect.

rules.legality: Source driver holds valid/data until actual ready handshake; reset cancels presentation.
rules.responses: Output transaction acceptance requires mvalid && mready.
rules.reset: Synchronous reset cancels outstanding accepted inputs; unique accepted payload identity used for residue attribution.
rules.stall: Previous mvalid && !mready requires current valid and same payload, unless reset.
rules.loss: Finite fair drain >=18 ready/input-idle samples, RAM depth <=8 and pipeline <=2.
rules.target_credit: First independent violation per reset epoch; later events remain attribution unknown.
